{"reason":"v1 has a 0.714 false-arbitration rate despite 1.0 recall; six of eight shown false positives have confidence below 0.70. Adding the high-confidence gate filters those costly rows while preserving the magnitude, exposure, and frozen-horizon safeguards, supporting the recall gate.","source":"(define (should-arbitrate? edi-change inventory-exposure)
  (and (> (abs (change-pct edi-change)) 0.15)
       (> inventory-exposure 500000)
       (not (frozen-horizon? edi-change))
       (high-confidence? edi-change)))"}
